events.event_name: EnKō Beauty Launch at The Canvas SoHo
events.address: The Canvas SoHo, 456 W Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: The official EnKō Beauty launch at The Canvas SoHo, with the collection available to discover in person and the founder on site.
events.what_is_free: The first 40 guests through the door receive a goodie bag featuring products from Vollie, EnKō Beauty and Marylia Scott Cosmetics.
events.caveats: RSVP is required, subject to host approval, and admission at the door remains at The Canvas team's discretion. The first-40 goodie bag is quantity-limited.
events.practical_notes: Do not treat registration as guaranteed admission; wait for approval before planning around this event.

events.brand: Prototype × Dover Street Market New York
events.address: Dover Street Market New York, 160 Lexington Ave, New York, NY 10016
events.what_it_is: A launch event for Prototype Issue Zero by Alastair McKimm at Dover Street Market New York.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the launch is not advertised with a ticket price; no take-home giveaway is promised.
events.caveats: RSVP is essential. Dover Street Market instructs guests to RSVP by email at RSVP@dsm-ny.com; no HTTP registration URL is provided.
events.practical_notes: Email the official RSVP address and do not assume admission without confirmation.

events.brand: Mattiasgollin × Dover Street Market New York
events.address: Dover Street Market New York, 160 Lexington Ave, New York, NY 10016
events.what_it_is: A two-day physical retail experience from independent Milanese designer Mattiasgollin at Dover Street Market New York.
events.what_is_free: Free access to browse the retail experience; merchandise is for sale and no giveaway is advertised.
events.caveats: Limited-time retail experience. The official listing does not state an RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Go during the published 11 AM–6 PM window; the event is only listed for two days.

events.address: TOKIO7, 83 E 7th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A three-day designer and archive pop-up with pieces from Rick Owens, Undercover, Raf Simons, Hysteric Glamour, Vetements and other labels.
events.what_is_free: Free access to browse the pop-up; merchandise is for sale and no take-home giveaway is advertised.
events.caveats: The source flyer describes the pop-up as open. Eventbrite also provides a ticket page, so reserving is available even though a walk-in requirement is not established.
events.practical_notes: Use the Eventbrite page if you want a reservation record; the pop-up itself is presented as open.

events.address: Colbo NYC, 51 Orchard St, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: MAIDENS SHOP's third international NYC pop-up, featuring one-of-a-kind pieces, Japanese labels, its first NYC womenswear offering, Whopeez vintage and records selected by Colbo founder Tal.
events.what_is_free: Free access to browse the pop-up; coffee is part of the in-store experience, while clothing, vintage and records are retail items.
events.caveats: The official announcement does not publish an RSVP requirement or promise any free merchandise.
events.practical_notes: This is primarily a shopping pop-up; go for the curated Japanese and vintage selection rather than expecting a giveaway.

events.event_name: ITSJUSTJILI Launch + Pop-Up at The Canvas SoHo
events.address: The Canvas SoHo, 456 W Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A launch party followed by a multi-day shoppable pop-up for upcycling designer Jili's one-of-one SS27 collection.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the approved launch/pop-up; no giveaway is promised. Garments are available to shop.
events.caveats: RSVP is required and subject to host approval. Admission at the door remains at The Canvas team's discretion. Public retail hours after the September 10 launch are not stated on the event page.
events.practical_notes: The launch is 6–8 PM September 10. For September 11–13, confirm retail hours with The Canvas before going.

events.event_name: Afrikrea NYFW Pop-Up: Created by Africa and the African Diaspora
events.what_it_is: A three-day marketplace of independent Black-owned fashion brands and designers from Africa and the African diaspora, with apparel, accessories and jewelry available to shop.
events.what_is_free: Free access to browse and meet designers; merchandise is for sale and no giveaway is advertised.
events.caveats: Eventbrite provides registration. The source flyer also labels the marketplace open, so registration is treated as available rather than a proven walk-in prohibition.
events.practical_notes: Register through Eventbrite if you want the cleanest access path; shopping purchases are optional.

events.address: Bowery Showroom, 55 Delancey St, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: Bhai New York's NYFW pop-up for a new collection release with live music.
events.what_is_free: Free drinks and snacks are advertised for attendees; the new collection is available to view and shop.
events.caveats: Partiful marks event activity as restricted to RSVP'd guests, so RSVP is required for the cleanest confirmed access.
events.practical_notes: RSVP before going; this is a public-facing fashion pop-up but the host is using a guest-list system.
